title: Cow comfort practices:
text:
Cow comfort practices:

1. Installation of ventilation and cooling system.
Industrial fans
Sprinklers

2. Establish secure cow pathway.
Concrete cow path

3. Application of beddings.
Hay straw
Sand

4. Establish a mosquito/fly control program.

Dairysquare – Dairy Farming Module
Page 41

images.label: Industrial fans
images.description: Large industrial fans installed overhead along the barn roof structure to provide ventilation for dairy cows.

images.label: Sprinklers
images.description: Row of water misting nozzles or sprinklers spraying a fine cooling mist over cows to relieve heat stress.

images.label: Concrete cow path
images.description: A dedicated, secure concrete walkway between green pastures and trees with cows walking along it accompanied by a handler.

images.label: Hay straw bedding
images.description: Dairy cows resting and standing on a thick, dry bedding made of hay or straw inside a barn.

images.label: Sand bedding
images.description: A dairy cow lying comfortably inside a free-stall cubicle layered with deep sand bedding.

facts: Cow comfort practice 1 is the installation of a ventilation and cooling system.
Industrial fans and sprinklers are examples of equipment used in ventilation and cooling systems for cows.
Cow comfort practice 2 is establishing a secure cow pathway.
A concrete cow path is an example of an established secure pathway for dairy cows.
Cow comfort practice 3 is the application of beddings.
Hay straw and sand are common materials used as bedding for cow comfort.
Cow comfort practice 4 is establishing a mosquito/fly control program.
The page belongs to the Dairysquare – Dairy Farming Module (Page 41).

questions.question: Which of the following cooling equipment are specifically highlighted on page 41 as part of ventilation and cooling systems?

options.D: Evaporative swamp coolers and chilled drinking pipes

questions.question: What type of secure cow pathway is specifically shown in the photograph under Cow Comfort Practice #2?
According to the guide, which two materials are pictured and recommended for the application of cow beddings?
True or False: Establishing a mosquito/fly control program is explicitly listed as one of the recommended cow comfort practices.

options.A: True, it is listed as practice #4 under cow comfort practices.
options.B: False, fly control is only considered an environmental sanitation practice, not cow comfort.
options.C: False, insect control is deemed harmful to cow comfort.
options.D: False, only chemical tick dipping is recommended.

questions.question: In the photograph labeled 'Sand', what is the dairy cow doing?

options.A: Lying comfortably in a free-stall bedded with sand
options.B: Feeding from an automated mixer wagon
options.C: Walking along a secure concrete alleyway
options.D: Being milked in a parallel milking parlor

questions.question: Which cow comfort practice corresponds to the use of overhead industrial fans and water sprinklers?

options.A: Installation of ventilation and cooling system
